item.title: A new Android malware from Google
item.description:
📝 Over the past few months, devices around the world have been infected with this novel strain, with as many as 4 billion Android handsets and tablets estimated to have already been contaminated, meaning that around half of all humanity may be at risk from this threat. For this fairly narrow threat vector of malware recidivism, a variety of considerably less draconian solutions have been proposed. Play Protect itself could be enhanced to scrutinize more closely those newly-installed apps that have elevated permissions or that were obtained through suspect channels, continuing with their recently touted advances in on-device security capabilities.
🔗 Read more: https://f-droid.org/2026/07/01/adv-malware.html

item.title: We Don't Have to Be This Bad at Improving Society
item.description:
📝 In situations of high uncertainty, many people excuse poor decisions to launch major initiatives that ends up failing by arguing that there wasn’t enough information available, so there was nothing they could have done to reduce the risk. I’m super curious about ideas, insights, and ways of thinking that could improve how political reforms are carried out in Danish politics today. This seems like a super valuable meta problem to solve and that is the kind of question that really stimulates my systems-thinking-addicted brain.
🔗 Read more: https://kasperjunge.com/blog/we-dont-have-to-be-this-bad-at-improving-society/
